claim_leads.claim: IRGC statement on October 29 that three or more tankers hit Iranian sea mines by using an 'unauthorized' southern Strait of Hormuz route
claim_leads.required: Per-hull IMO IDs, UKMTO incident reconciliation, mechanism, verifiable timing and external legal authority; do not merge with Louise 1 limpet mine attack or assume Tehran's asserted legal authority.

claim_leads.claim: Iranian navy Rear Admiral Jalil Moghadam October 29 claims of over 20 operations against US warships and 300 against US interests
claim_leads.required: Full list of claimed incidents, deduplicated target identities, event clock, outcome evidence and relevant US responses; an exact tally implies testable accounting.

claim_leads.claim: IRGC October 30 claim of destroyed US unmanned surface craft in eastern Hormuz
claim_leads.required: US military confirmation, hull identity, remote telemetry, imagery, independent media or physical recovery.

claim_leads.claim: Houthi denial of Saudi allegation that a drone was directed toward Mecca
claim_leads.required: Saudi air-defense geospatial track and Houthi launch evidence; separate interception from intention and end-target.

claim_leads.claim: Saudi attribution of Taiz October 29 deaths from an airstrike, reported by Houthi health authorities
claim_leads.required: Independent local investigation, site damage imagery, named incident event ID and casualty provenance.

claim_leads.claim: Satellite collection suggests Russia transmitted tactical targeting intelligence to Houthis and Iraq militias
claim_leads.required: Distinguish visible orbital geometry and tasking from a demonstrated sensor-to-shooter transfer; assess independent official testimony or physical evidence.

claim_leads.claim: Iran has operationally reverse-engineered GBU-57 MOP and possesses new laser weapons
claim_leads.required: Carry forward original October 18 speaker/translation; differentiate recovered pieces, engineering research and full operational capability.

referrals.claims_forensics: Evaluate the above seven claim families under the controlled WOL/Lie Ledger rules: stable proposition/actor IDs, exact original language, repetition-versus-new-claim, evidence/source chronology, falsity vs knowledge, corrections, source-propagation relationships. No automatic new LIE ruling and no changes to prior adjudications by evidence ingestion.
referrals.public_product: Update claim checks and chronology from owner-qualified outcomes only, and keep reported actor claims visually and verbally separate from verified damage.
referrals.map_review: Add no point coordinate for 25NM-NE-Khasab approximation until evidence establishes map-grade coordinate; leave existing base operational classification unchanged absent facility-specific proof.
referrals.economic_review: Use only dated source-specific intraday futures/market observations; do not mix with protected EIA Brent spot series or produce a 2026 October realized total using incomplete observations.
